paite: Ka Ka aw in, TOUPA ka sam a; ka aw in TOUPA kiang ah hehpihna ka ngen hi.
heading: David La / Kokhuk A Om Lai A Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

paite: Ama ah ka mangbat thu ka sungbua a; ama ah ka buaina ka theisak hi.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

paite: Ka sung a ka kha abah lai in, nang ka lampi na thei a! Ka paina lampi ah ka awkna ding in thang aguk kam uhi.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

paite: Ka taklam ah om inla, en dih, kuamah hon thei a-om kei ua; ka kihumbitna a-omta kei a; kuamah himhim in ka hinna alimsakta kei hi.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka hon sam a, “Nang ka kihumbitna, mihing gam a ka tantuam na hi," ka chi a.
english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

paite: Ka kikou husa ngaikhia in; nakpitak in hihniam in ka om hi. Hon simmohte lak ah hon humbit in, kei sang in ahatzaw ngal ua.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

paite: Na min ka phattheihna ding in, ka hinna suangkul a kipan in pikhia in, midiktatte'n hon umsuak ding ua; nang hoihtak a na hon hih ding ziak in.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
